wiki.title: Whirly Willis
wiki.text:
Whirly Willis is a robgoblin NPC that can be found in Sunstone Valley. He is a shinyseeker who had been help with the player, Dorn, Peace-guana Joe, and the Freewheelers to fight against the Skullz.
